newsitem.title: USA: Brown Disc says merger agreement expired.
newsitem.headline: Brown Disc says merger agreement expired.

text.p: Brown Disk Products Co Inc said Monday its previously announced merger agreement with Kimbrough Computer Sales Inc expired September 15 without a deal being consummated.
Kimbrough is also known as Solution, System and Service Integration.
Brown Disc said conditions for the merger had not been met, including common stock equity financing of about $4.4 million.
It said negotiations with prospective investors to obtain the equity financing had not been successful.
Brown Disk said it will continue to seek acquisitions of assets and businesses and will focus on electronic software distribution via Internet and cable.
